agent.name: Organizational Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: Organizational readiness to absorb govern and sustain a specified application

analytical_question: For the hypothetical financial-services chart-agent proposal, distinguish readiness to plan, execute isolated public/synthetic learning, and operate next-quarter routine service under the missing_budget organizational evidence profile without importing capabilities from another packet.
general_et_finding: Agentic AI combines model-selected tool actions, observations, scoped permissions and a human stop path; it creates organizational duties beyond ordinary BI charting: competent source checking, error escalation, access control, audit lineage, change management, monitoring, fallback and continuous service coverage. Its technology maturity cannot be inferred from this organization’s permission, staff or budget. C1 and C3 frame adoption as separate technology, task and organizational questions; S1/S2 offer voluntary role and lifecycle guidance, not proof of implementation.
application_finding: For human-supervised chart review, an analyst would submit a public or synthetic chart and its source table; read-only agent tools would draft source-linked discrepancy notes, which a qualified human accepts or rejects before any publication. Correct denominators, label interpretation, context and uncertainty matter; exceptions and ambiguous graphics require abstention/escalation. Task/technology fit and reproducible technical performance remain UNVALIDATED and comparative net advantage versus manual and deterministic review UNKNOWN in all four packets. Neither an approval nor a training dry run establishes accuracy, reduced total review burden or safe routine use.
organization_specific_finding:
CASE missing_budget | Eight-domain case-evidence profile; SUPPORTED always limited to explicitly stated scope, PARTIAL is qualified and UNKNOWN is not failure:
Leadership/sponsorship — SUPPORTED for scoped POC: Evidence: Charter, reporting sponsor, service owner/deputy and scoped approval documented. Consequence: No routine-use release authority. Closure: Sponsor requests separate post-evidence operating release.
Skills/training — SUPPORTED for scoped POC: Evidence: Ordinary BI reviewers completed recorded source-trace/error-escalation exercises; maintainer protected. Consequence: Agent performance remains untested. Closure: Analytics lead maintains coverage and tests representative tasks before expanding.
Workflow/process — SUPPORTED for scoped POC: Evidence: Dry run documents sign-off, exception handoff and manual fallback. Consequence: Actual handling time and error rates unknown. Closure: Service owner captures end-to-end effort and exception outcomes.
Infrastructure/data — SUPPORTED for scoped POC: Evidence: Approved isolated read-only route, least privilege, lineage and test logs stipulated. Consequence: Not a production-qualified route. Closure: Security rechecks controls and trace completeness; separate production approval.
Resources/budget — PARTIAL: Evidence: Finance confirms ONLY 24-hour total protected POC cap; next-quarter amount, approval, funding duration explicitly UNKNOWN. Consequence: POC can be scoped, but no assurance of sustainable paid reviewer/maintenance coverage. Closure: Finance owner supplies signed next-quarter amount, period, staffing/support coverage, contingency, approval and review date.
Governance/risk — SUPPORTED for scoped POC: Evidence: Signed incident/stop/change controls and witnessed restore-to-manual exercise. Consequence: No tested real agent behavior or routine release. Closure: Risk owner monitors study incidents and rehearses new scenarios.
Culture/change — SUPPORTED for scoped POC: Evidence: Representative feedback, participation, dissent and nonpunitive error channels documented. Consequence: No demonstrated sustained acceptance at measured workload. Closure: Analytics manager records observed burden/feedback throughout learning.
Operating ownership — PARTIAL: Evidence: Reporting owner/deputy, stop authority, maintenance and monthly monitoring assigned, but recurring paid coverage unfunded/unverified. Consequence: Named roles may not have capacity next quarter. Closure: Service owner links signed rota, hours and support continuity to finance approval.
Scope conclusions: PLAN: READY_TO_PLAN. ISOLATED POC: CONDITIONALLY_READY_FOR_SCOPED_LEARNING with the fictional four-week permission and distinct 24-hour total POC cap, subject to unchanged staffing, route and controls; missing recurring allocation does not negate funded isolated learning. ROUTINE: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_FOR_SUSTAINED_USE; next-quarter funding approval/amount/period and actual value plus operating release are missing.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: All four cases share UNVALIDATED task/technology fit and UNKNOWN net advantage; no comparative agent trial or measured efficacy is provided.
T1 H2 readiness assumptions and other case premises cannot establish this case’s organization; no cross-case borrowing.
Case approvals and rehearsals are fictional stipulated premises, not independent enterprise audit, real deployment or certification.
Human review required by policy does not by itself prove an appointed competent or protected reviewer.
S1/S2 are voluntary editions, not binding regulation or evidence of current company implementation.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence that 24-hour POC and organizational preparation are stipulated, while next-quarter recurring funding amount/approval/duration is not supplied. Not evidence that funds are zero. Empirical value/operating release unknown. Case checked 2026-11-04, NIST editions 2023-01/2024-07.
value_opportunity_implication: Potentially fewer chart-claim checking hours with stronger traceability, but the net benefit is UNKNOWN until comparative representative testing includes false/missed corrections, human correction, maintenance and support time. Conventional manual plus deterministic checks remain the baseline. Organizational readiness does not prove utility or authorize an adoption posture change.
risk_governance_implication: Main consequences are wrong denominators, invented links, privacy/access breach, misleading reports and inappropriate executive reliance. Restrict to reversible source-linked drafts, independently human-authorized publication, least privilege, full logs, escalation, incident stops, reviewer coverage and manual recovery. The risk owner must set materiality/tolerances; do not mistake a dry run for technical validation or assert legal compliance.
recommendation_management_implication:
Binding gap for routine sustainability is the specifically UNKNOWN next-quarter funding/coverage, not missing POC resources. P1 supplied finance owner with reporting service owner, before any routine recommendation: provide signed next-quarter amount, approval, funding duration, ordinary-reviewer/deputy/support hours, maintenance/monitoring coverage and contingency; closure dated budget artifact and matched staffing rota; blocks routine only. P2 supplied sponsor and risk owner: reconfirm 24-hour POC cap, charter, route, exercises and stop conditions before conditional learning; closure current signoff; blocks POC if changed. P3 supplied service owner/analytics reviewers: run only conditional bounded study and compare actual source traces, errors, comprehensive labor and feedback against manual/deterministic baseline; closure audit logs and feasibility/value review; blocks favorable operating claim. P4 sponsor: seek separate risk/operating release after evidence and budget; closure signed release, not presumed from prepared profile.
CONDITIONAL DESIGN, not an executed study: across four weeks use analyst-submitted public/synthetic charts and source tables, read-only agent-generated source-linked notes, a qualified reviewer deciding accept/reject, and human-only publication. The case has hypothetical scoped permission; execution remains conditional on explicit reconfirmation of all human, timing, technical and risk gates. Only prepared-profile/missing-budget cases have a confirmed 24-hour TOTAL protected POC cap; propose allocating 4 hours scope/tolerance agreement, 5 setup/control confirmation, 9 representative tasks/review, 4 exception/absence/incident drills and 2 evidence/debrief, with real time tracked and hard stop at 24. Agree task breadth, materiality/error tolerance and success criteria BEFORE execution; use normal, ambiguous and adversarial/incorrect-denominator samples plus absent-reviewer and incident/restore drills. Capture reproducible source traces, missed/false corrections, abstentions, unsupported claims, total setup/review/correction/support labor, reviewer feedback, cover and restore outcomes; compare manual/deterministic best baseline, not just model output. Stop and revert to manual review for forbidden access, publication escape, missing lineage/oversight, cap exhaustion, absent qualified coverage or material unsupported claims. Review in week four or earlier on incidents or changes to staff/model/data terms. Separate feasibility, incremental value and sustainable governance exit decisions; zero errors on a small set cannot certify production.
change_monitoring_triggers: Four-week review of actual control, trace, accuracy, effort and acceptance records, if an authorized study occurs; otherwise review documented readiness progress only.
Immediate reassessment after incident, lost lineage, forbidden access, changed model/tool/data terms, lost sponsor/reviewer/deputy or cap exhaustion.

Before any routine proposal, reassess next-quarter owner/cover, recurring signed budget, performance/value versus best baseline and separately granted risk/operating approval; quarterly thereafter if released.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: EXPLICIT CONDITION: No affirmative assurance of routine use until representative task performance/net value, authorized production route and risk release, funded covered owner/deputy and continued monitoring are evidenced; do not run a real trial based on this analysis.

MoE organizational intake (put labelled subfields inside existing capabilities_constraints/additional_context, not extra output keys): case/run ID; requested plan/POC/routine scope and horizon; evidence-as-of date and each document/source owner; sponsor/charter/permission/residual-risk decision rights; named service owner/deputy/rota and protected ordinary-user reviewer competency; handoff, signoff, exceptions, full review effort and fallback; approved model/tool/data route, access, isolation, logs and lineage; POC cap/hours/approver versus separately signed recurring amount/period/coverage/contingency; representative consultation/feedback/dissent; incident-stop-change authority and tested restore; monitoring, support, retirement and reassessment triggers.

Handoff to Adoption Agent/human: PLAN: READY_TO_PLAN. ISOLATED POC: CONDITIONALLY_READY_FOR_SCOPED_LEARNING with the fictional four-week permission and distinct 24-hour total POC cap, subject to unchanged staffing, route and controls; missing recurring allocation does not negate funded isolated learning. ROUTINE: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_FOR_SUSTAINED_USE; next-quarter funding approval/amount/period and actual value plus operating release are missing. Binding dependency: recurring budget and matched next-quarter cover for routine use. Carry closure artifacts, remaining limitations and change triggers forward without overturning T1 baseline DEFER automatically.
